title.narrative: Central District Water and Sanitation Services Reform Program
Programa de Reforma de los Servicios de Agua y Saneamiento en el Distrito Central

description.narrative: El objetivo de esta serie programtica es contribuir a mejorar la calidad e incrementar el acceso a los servicios de Agua y Saneamiento (AyS) en el Distrito Central (DC) a travs de un proceso de reformas que permitan consolidar la municipalizacin de los servicios de AyS mejorando la gobernanza sectorial y su gestin, en un contexto de cambio climtico y conducente a la seguridad hdrica. El objetivo de esta primera operacin es contribuir con el diseo y promulgacin de instrumentos legales y sectoriales. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) promover el desarrollo operativo y de gestin que permita incrementar la eficiencia en la prestacin de AyS de UMAPS; (ii) contribuir a mejorar la sostenibilidad financiera de los servicios prestados por la UMAPS; (iii) fortalecer la planificacin de la UMAPS; y (iv) fortalecer el marco sectorial a travs de una mejor rectora, regulacin, gestin del recurso en un contexto de cambio climtico, y prestacin para atender mejor la demanda por los servicios. Esta es la primera operacin de una serie de dos operaciones, consecutivas de un solo desembolso, independientes pero vinculadas tcnicamente, bajo la modalidad de prstamo Programtico Basado en Poltica (PBP).

The objective of this programmatic series is to help increase access and improve the quality of water and sanitation services in the Central District through a process of reforms that permit decentralization of those services to the municipal level, thereby enhancing sector governance and management in a context of climate change and with a view to achieving water security. The objective of this first operation is to contribute to the design and enactment of legal and sector instruments. The specific objectives are: (i) to promote operational and management development so as to increase the efficiency of water and sanitation services provided by the Municipal Water and Sanitation Unit (UMAPS); (ii) to help increase the financial sustainability of services provided by UMAPS; (iii) to strengthen UMAPS planning; and (iv) to strengthen the sector framework though better governance, regulation, and management of resources in a context of climate change, and improve service delivery to better meet demand. This is the first loan in a series of two consecutive single-tranche operations that are technically related to one another but independently financed as programmatic policy-based loans.
